name: Kill then hold - a full movement cadence before the next step
notes: A trooper starts already in melee range of a runner, so it never has to move to open the fight - every tick until the runner dies is a stand-and-swing. A second runner sits further down the row, out of range, so once the first dies the trooper has somewhere new to walk to and the hold becomes observable: does its first step toward the second runner land no sooner than one full movement cadence after the kill, or does it move the very next tick as if nothing happened? Owner playtest, 2026-08-22: "when a unit kills an enemy, it should wait a full movement cooldown before starting to move again... it is hard to see who won that fight."
